overrides.description: Members of this prestige class are massive creatures who revel in uprooting enormous objects - boulders, trees, even structures - and launching them at enemies with devastating force.

Area Attack.description: Instead of targeting a creature directly, the character rolls an attack against the square the target occupies (AC 10). Every creature in that square must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + the hulking hurler's ranged attack bonus) or suffer full damage. This technique can only be used with weapons of Huge size or larger.

Catch Weapon.description: A hulking hurler receives the Snatch Arrows feat as a bonus, regardless of whether he meets its normal prerequisites. He can catch thrown weapons of his own size category or smaller, and may immediately hurl a caught weapon back at the attacker if he wishes.

Knockdown Blow.description: When the hulking hurler lands a damaging hit against a Medium or smaller creature, the target is knocked prone.

Meteor Strike.description: By spending a full-round action, the hulking hurler adds double his Strength bonus to the damage of a successful thrown weapon attack.

Overburdened Heave.description: The hulking hurler can hurl a weapon up to two size categories larger than himself, or throw any object weighing up to his medium load capacity (for example, a Large hulking hurler with 25 Strength could launch a Gargantuan javelin or a rock weighing up to 533 pounds).

Ranged Power Attack.description: When the target is within 30 feet, the hulking hurler may apply the Power Attack feat to attacks made with thrown weapons.

Really Throw Anything.description: A hulking hurler receives the Throw Anything feat as a bonus. Because this class relies on sheer physical might rather than finesse, the character can hurl any object he is capable of lifting as a light load - not just weapons. When throwing an improvised weapon, he suffers only a -2 penalty on the attack roll rather than the standard -4. The range increment for any thrown weapon or improvised weapon used by a hulking hurler is 10 feet, plus an additional 5 feet for each size category he exceeds Large.

Two-handed Hurl Trick.description: At 2nd level and once more at 3rd level, the hulking hurler selects one of the following special techniques. To employ any of these tricks, the character must grasp the weapon or improvised weapon with both hands and throw it as a full-round action.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.

classFeatures.description: Hulking hurlers gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.
classFeatures.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency

classFeatures.description: A hulking hurler gains the Snatch Arrows feat even if he does not meet the prerequisites. He may catch weapons of his size or smaller (and hurl them back at the attacker immediately if he chooses).
classFeatures.name: Catch Weapon

classFeatures.description: A hulking hurler gains the Throw Anything feat (described in Chapter 3 of this book) as a bonus feat. However, since a hulking hurler depends on brute strength more than skill, he can throw anything (not just weapons) he can lift as a light load. If the item is an improvised weapon, he takes a -2 penalty on his attack roll instead of the normal -4. Use the rules in Chapter 4 of this book to determine the amount of damage the thrown weapon does. The range increment of a thrown weapon or improvised weapon wielded by a hulking hurler is 10 feet + 5 feet per size category the hulking hurler is beyond Large (this is a modification of the Throw Anything feat).
classFeatures.name: Really Throw Anything

classFeatures.description: At 2nd level and again at 3rd level, a hulking hurler chooses one of the following tricks. In order to use any of these abilities, the hulking hurler must grip the weapon or improvised weapon in two hands and throw it as a full-round action. Area Attack: The character makes an attack roll against a square the target creature occupies (AC 10) rather than the creature itself. Any creature in the square must succeed on a Reflex save (DC 10 + the hulking hurler's ranged attack bonus) or take full damage. This ability may only be used with a Huge or larger weapon. Knockdown Blow: If the hulking hurler's attack hits and does damage to any creature of Medium or smaller size, the target is rendered prone. Meteor Strike: As a full-round action, a hulking hurler deals extra damage equal to twice his Strength bonus on a successful hit with a thrown weapon. Overburdened Heave: The hulking hurler can throw a weapon up to two sizes larger than his size category, or an item that weighs as much as his medium load (so a Large hulking hurler with a Strength score of 25 could heave a Gargantuan javelin or a rock weighing up to 533 pounds). Ranged Power Attack: If the target is within 30 feet, the hulking hurler can use Power Attack with his thrown weapon.
classFeatures.name: Two-handed Hurl Trick

raw.description: Hulking hurlers belong to those races of generously proportioned creatures who enjoy nothing more than wrenching boulders, trees, and even buildings free of their earthly bonds and throwing them at their foes.
raw.name: Hulking Hurler

prerequisites.text: Base Attack Bonus: +5 Feats: Point Blank Shot, Power Attack, Weapon Focus ((any thrown weapon)) Special: Large size or larger.
